chapter: Moving, Columbia Missouri and leaving home
title: Army discipline as a school for manhood
summary: Thompson says the army teaches immaculateness and manhood to people who cannot go to school.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: No, sir. But not only that, you're not allowed to be nasty.

In the army. They won't tolerate it. You have to lie down and make your bed, just like they say in the boy scouts, you have to learn how to be a man, and be immaculate. In the army you have to make your bed every day. This is why the army is a good place for a lot of people who aren't able to go to school, or other things, because you can learn how to be a man. You can learn how to be somebody that
Because you have to learn, somewhere you have to be able to learn.
